description: This source file defines a utility class 'ReferenceCleaner' used for cleaning up Java references (soft, phantom, weak) via a background thread. The class manages a dedicated cleanup thread that processes reference queues to remove references when they are no longer reachable.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner
classes.description: A utility class providing mechanisms to clean up references (soft, phantom, weak) in Java with an internal cleanup thread.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.CleanerThread
classes.description: A daemon thread that continuously processes reference queue to invoke remove() on cleaned references.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Removable
classes.description: An interface for references that can perform cleanup actions via remove() method.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Soft
classes.description: A wrapper around SoftReference that implements Removable for cleanup.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Phantom
classes.description: A wrapper around PhantomReference that implements Removable for cleanup.

classes.name: ReferenceCleaner.Weak
classes.description: A wrapper around WeakReference that implements Removable for cleanup.

methods.name: stopRunning
methods.description: Sets the flag to stop the cleaner thread loop.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Defines the main loop of the cleaner thread, which processes references from the queue and invokes their remove() method.
